description: A round trip's derived document projected to the same harness a second time and read back: the key paths lost, gained or changed between pass 1 and pass 2. Anything listed is accumulating encoding error and must be declared.

oneOf.description: Both passes read; this is what moved between them.

changed.description: Key paths in both whose values differ (ids, timestamps, escaping, path spelling).

gained.description: Key paths present only after pass 2.

lost.description: Key paths of pass 1's document absent after pass 2.

oneOf.description: Pass 1 or pass 2 could not be read; there is nothing to compare.

title: twice_around snapshot
